description: Implementation of POSIX pthread functions for Windows platform, including thread creation, joining, and condition variable waiting, specific to the Git project environment.

classes.name: pthread_t
classes.description: Structure representing a thread in the Git Windows portability layer.

methods.name: unsigned __stdcall win32_start_routine(void * arg)
methods.description: Internal thread start routine that executes the callback and sets the thread ID.

methods.name: int pthread_create(pthread_t * thread,const void * attr UNUSED,void * (* start_routine)(void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Creates a new thread using Windows API and initializes the pthread_t structure.

methods.name: int win32_pthread_join(pthread_t * thread,void ** value_ptr)
methods.description: Waits for a thread to finish and retrieves its return value.

methods.name: pthread_t pthread_self(void)
methods.description: Returns the current thread's pthread_t representation.

methods.name: int pthread_cond_wait(pthread_cond_t * cond,pthread_mutex_t * mutex)
methods.description: Blocks on a condition variable with an associated mutex.
